# InsightsOut

> InsightsOut (insightsout.work) is a San Francisco company founded by Nima Imani that works on the human side of AI change and leadership. For organizations: leadership coaching and alignment, manager and team work for human–AI teams (onboarding agents as teammates, deciding who decides what, communicating under pressure), coaching for people whose roles are changing, and the technology solution built with the team. For founders and builders: 1:1 and co-founder coaching on conflict, overwhelm, and decisions under uncertainty, aimed at product-market fit, the raise, and revenue. For small business owners and individuals: AI transformation consulting and coaching (more revenue, less time and money wasted), starting with a free consultation. For everyone: public workshops in San Francisco and research built from what people share in these rooms. One purpose underneath: protecting and strengthening human agency and leadership during rapid change. Founder: Nima Imani, an ICF-certified, ontologically trained coach with 10+ years in software, data and AI (EY, Neo4j).

## Who we help, in one line each
- Organizations whose teams are already human–AI teams (10x productivity = 10x more decisions and communication) → start with one Leadership Conversation.
- Managers whose teams are overwhelmed or whose roles are changing → manager and team workshops; the public entry is "My Team Is Overwhelmed."
- Founders carrying more decisions than one person can hold → From Uncertainty to Clear Decisions (3-month 1:1 program).
- Co-founders (or founder + key lead) having the same argument on repeat → Co-Founder & Team Alignment (3-month program for founding pairs), ending in a one-page Working Agreement.
- Small business owners, coaches, consultants, and individuals left behind on AI → free consultation, then AI transformation consulting and coaching.
- Anyone in San Francisco who wants to think this through with peers → weekly Founder Group Coaching (Fridays 2 pm at SF Commons, $10) and other workshops on Luma.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://insightsout.work/): what InsightsOut is and the three ways to work with us.
- [Founder Coaching](https://insightsout.work/coaching): the two 3-month programs, FAQ, testimonials, how to book a free 30-minute call.
- [Organizations](https://insightsout.work/organizations): for organizations running human–AI teams — 10x productivity means 10x more decisions and communication; leadership coaching and alignment, manager and team work on onboarding agents as teammates, coaching for people in role change, and the technology solution built with the team. Starts with one Leadership Conversation.
- [AI Transformation](https://insightsout.work/ai-transformation): consulting and coaching for small business owners, coaches, consultants, and individuals left behind on AI — get the most from AI, more revenue, less time and money wasted; a free 30-minute consultation puts numbers on it first, then working automations are built together and the owner is coached to run them.
- [Events](https://insightsout.work/events): all upcoming workshops and the live Luma calendar.
- [About](https://insightsout.work/about): what InsightsOut is, Nima Imani's background, FAQ.

## Workshops (each documented in full on the site; register on Luma)
- [My Team Is Overwhelmed. How Do I Lead Through Uncertainty?](https://insightsout.work/workshops/my-team-is-overwhelmed): 90-minute sensemaking session for middle managers and team leads leading teams through AI change. Free.
- [AI Is Changing Everything. What Should Stay Human?](https://insightsout.work/workshops/what-should-stay-human): 3-hour working session to find your own line, what to hand over and what should stay human. Free.
- [AI for the Rest of Us](https://insightsout.work/workshops/ai-for-the-rest-of-us): no-jargon facilitated conversation for people who feel left behind by AI. Free.
- [Founder Group Coaching & Peer Support](https://insightsout.work/workshops/founder-group-coaching): weekly small-group coaching for founders, Fridays 2 pm, SF Commons (550 Laguna St, North Studio), $10, free for SF Commons members.
- [The Argument You Keep Having](https://insightsout.work/workshops/the-argument-you-keep-having): 2-hour working session for founding pairs ending in a first draft working agreement. $90 per person, $180 per pair.

## Research (living papers, updated as new workshop waves land)
- [Working Through AI Change](https://insightsout.work/research/working-through-ai-change): the human side of AI-driven change, read against Gallup, Microsoft, MIT SMR, SHRM, Anthropic.
- [When Your Role Starts Changing](https://insightsout.work/research/when-your-role-starts-changing): the individual side — where role change is felt, who names fear, why people ask for a map not a course.
- [From Overwhelm to Clarity](https://insightsout.work/research/from-overwhelm-to-clarity): the founder side — overwhelm as pace and fragmentation, fear unnamed, wanting a place to think with peers.
- [How We Do Research](https://insightsout.work/research/methodology): questions, coding, cross-checks, publishing thresholds, versioning.

- Founder: Nima Imani (LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/imaninima/). Location: San Francisco, CA. Works online worldwide.

- Contact: nima@insightsout.work
- Point of view: AI lets people do more, so more lands on the person — more decisions, more overwhelm — and the people at the top stop seeing the same picture. Every team is already a human–AI team; 10x productivity means 10x more decisions and 10x more communication. AI change is a leadership challenge before it is a training challenge; technology without alignment is how rollouts stall.
